headline: Court Rejects Mining Dump Policy Review
summary: The High Court has declined to review its previous order regarding Goa's mining dump policy. The decision upholds the existing legal stance on the matter.

headline: HC Rejects Goa Foundation's Mining Plea
summary: The High Court dismissed a review petition filed by the Goa Foundation challenging the state's mining dump policy. This decision affirms the court's earlier stance on the issue.

headline: Goa Foundation's Mining Plea Dismissed by HC
summary: The High Court has thrown out a petition by the Goa Foundation that sought a review of the mining dump policy order. The ruling leaves the existing policy framework unchanged.

headline: Why Arjun Rampal Is Raising Kids in Goa
summary: Actor Arjun Rampal previously shared his reasons for choosing to raise his sons in Goa alongside partner Gabriella Demetriades. The couple appreciates the lifestyle and environment the state offers for their children.

headline: Arjun Rampal Marries Gabriella Demetriades
summary: Actor Arjun Rampal has tied the knot with his longtime partner Gabriella Demetriades in Goa. The couple decided to marry after being together for more than six years.

headline: Arjun Rampal and Gabriella Demetriades Wed
summary: Arjun Rampal and his partner Gabriella Demetriades have officially married in Goa. The wedding marks a new chapter for the couple after years of being together.

headline: Man Discharged in Rape Case
summary: A Goa court has discharged a man accused of rape, stating that the current law does not recognize marital rape. The ruling highlights the legal boundaries concerning sexual assault allegations within marriage.

headline: Road Development Funds in Goa at Risk
summary: Goa faces a potential loss of central road funds due to non-compliance with the Central Road and Infrastructure Fund (CRIF) guidelines. The state needs to address these compliance issues to secure the necessary infrastructure funding.

headline: DLF Goa Mall Reaches 64% Leased Status
summary: DLF's upcoming mall project in Goa has already leased out 64 percent of its space. The developers are aiming to launch the shopping center by the end of this year or early next year.

headline: Wedding Couples Shift Focus From Goa to Coorg
summary: Trend analysis suggests that destination wedding crowds in India are moving away from Goa in search of new locations like Coorg. This shift indicates changing preferences among couples planning their weddings.

headline: Kejriwal to Discuss Petrol Policy in Goa
summary: Arvind Kejriwal is scheduled to address a town hall meeting focused on the E20 petrol policy during his visit to Goa. The discussion will cover the implementation and impact of the new fuel policy.

headline: Arjun Tendulkar Confirms Goa Cricket Commitment
summary: All-rounder Arjun Tendulkar has put an end to rumors about his departure by committing to play for Goa. His decision ensures he will continue representing the state in the upcoming domestic season.

headline: CM Advises Youth on Entering Politics
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has advised young people to gain solid experience in education and employment before stepping into politics. He emphasized that professional stability is crucial for public service.

headline: Minister Proposes 'Plus-One' Plan for Tourists
summary: A Goa minister has advocated for a 'plus-one' economic strategy designed to encourage tourists to extend their stays. The goal is to boost local business revenues by keeping visitors in the state for longer periods.

headline: Cancer Declared Notifiable Disease in Goa
summary: The Goa government has officially declared cancer as a notifiable disease across the state. This move aims to improve data collection, track cases more accurately, and bolster healthcare services.

headline: Goa Opposes Tarun Tejpal's Appeal
summary: The Goa government informed the Supreme Court that journalist Tarun Tejpal should have surrendered before challenging his rape conviction. The state is questioning the legal admissibility of his appeal under current procedures.

headline: Tejpal Challenges Sentence in Supreme Court
summary: Tarun Tejpal has approached the Supreme Court to challenge his 10-year prison sentence. Meanwhile, the Goa government has raised questions regarding the maintainability of his legal appeal.

headline: Simple Wedding for Arjun and Gabriella
summary: Arjun Rampal and Gabriella Demetriades have solemnized their relationship through a simple registered marriage ceremony in Goa. The private event took place after several years of being partners.

headline: Scrapyard Policy Paused Despite Rising Fires
summary: Despite an increasing number of fire incidents, Goa's regulatory policy for scrapyards remains on hold. Local residents and authorities continue to express concern over the lack of safety guidelines.

headline: SC Reserves Order on Tejpal Surrender
summary: The Supreme Court has reserved its decision on Tarun Tejpal's surrender plea, while the Goa government has argued for life imprisonment. The legal battle continues as both sides present their final arguments.

headline: Homicide Charges Framed in Thar Crash Case
summary: A court in North Goa has framed culpable homicide charges against the accused in the December 2024 Thar accident case. The legal proceedings are moving forward following the fatal road incident.

headline: Call for Action on Illegal Parking in Calangute
summary: Residents of Calangute have called on authorities to tackle the growing problem of unauthorized bus and taxi parking in their neighborhood. The illegal parking has been causing traffic congestion and public inconvenience.

headline: Most Missing Kids Leave with Known Persons
summary: A child welfare unit in Goa has revealed that more than 95 percent of missing children leave their homes accompanied by someone they already know. This statistic highlights the nature of runaway and missing children cases in the region.

headline: Kejriwal to Speak on E20 Petrol in Goa
summary: During his upcoming trip to Goa, Arvind Kejriwal will lead a town hall session to discuss the national E20 petrol policy. The meeting will address public queries and policy implications for the state.

headline: Goa Special Education Teacher Wins National Award
summary: A teacher credited with revolutionizing special education in Goa has been honored with a prestigious national award. The recognition celebrates her dedicated efforts to support children with special needs.

headline: Stamp Law Amendment for 'Mhajo Flat' Scheme
summary: The state government plans to amend its stamp duty laws to facilitate the 'Mhajo Flat' housing scheme. This legal adjustment is intended to make homeownership more accessible for citizens.

headline: Vehicle Scrapping Unit Underutilized in Goa
summary: Goa's sole vehicle scrapping facility is currently operating at only 10 percent of its total capacity. The low utilization rate raises questions about the implementation of the state's vehicle condemnation policies.

headline: Crowds Gather for Sanguem Ganesh Lottery
summary: Large queues have formed in Sanguem as locals try their luck for the annual Ganesh festival jackpot lottery. The event draws massive crowds looking to win festive prizes.

headline: Politician Criticizes Hospital Equipment Delay
summary: Leader Viriato Fernandes has criticized the delay in procuring a CT scan machine for the Ponda government hospital. He highlighted the hardship this administrative delay causes to local patients.

headline: Margao Markets Face Severe Fire Risks
summary: Local markets in Margao are highly vulnerable to fire hazards due to a lack of water supply and blocked emergency escape routes. Shopkeepers and shoppers remain worried about safety as infrastructure lapses persist.

headline: Locals Worry About NH-66 Alignment Impact
summary: Residents of Chinchinim have raised concerns that the current alignment plans for the NH-66 highway expansion put several local homes at risk. They are demanding a review of the route to protect residential properties.

headline: Call to Remove AI Traffic Signal in Merces
summary: The Merces Gram Sabha has demanded the removal of an AI-enabled traffic signal, claiming it is causing severe traffic jams. Locals feel manual management or simpler systems would be more effective.

headline: Police Case Filed Against 14 in Temple Row
summary: Police in Goa have registered a case against 14 individuals involved in a dispute over a temple in Acoi. The move aims to restore order following a clash between opposing factions.

headline: Tensions Flare in Gram Sabhas Over Projects
summary: Gram Sabha meetings across Goa have witnessed rising tensions as villagers debate controversial crematorium projects, mega developments, and road expansions. Local communities are strongly demanding greater input in these decisions.

headline: Monument Buffer Zone Building Controls at Risk
summary: Experts warn that the regulation of construction activities around the buffer zones of centrally protected monuments in Goa is in jeopardy. Lax oversight could lead to unauthorized developments threatening historical heritage sites.

headline: Celebrating 25 Years of Katha Mala
summary: The Shennoi Goembab Katha Mala is celebrating its 25th anniversary of promoting Konkani storytelling and literature among youth. Over the past quarter-century, the initiative has helped younger generations connect with their cultural roots.

headline: Builder Ordered to Pay Maintenance Dues
summary: A local developer has been directed to clear outstanding maintenance dues amounting to Rs 19.7 lakh for unsold units in a housing project. The ruling provides relief to existing homeowners who were bearing the shared costs.

headline: Sarpanch Blames Outsiders for Calangute's Image
summary: The Calangute sarpanch has blamed non-locals and a lack of police action for the coastal town's deteriorating reputation. He called for stricter law enforcement to curb illegal activities.

headline: Two Arrested in Digital Arrest Scam
summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has arrested two individuals in connection with a money-laundering case linked to fake 'digital arrest' scams. The suspects allegedly processed illicit funds obtained by defrauding unsuspecting victims.

headline: Government Launches CM Avas Yojana Housing Scheme
summary: Under the CM Avas Yojana, the Goa government plans to provide affordable housing to ensure shelter for all residents in the state. The welfare program targets economically weaker sections of society.

headline: Luxury Eco-Tourism Project Cleared in Ambaulim
summary: The Goa government has approved a new luxury eco-tourism project slated for development in Ambaulim. The initiative aims to attract high-end tourists while incorporating sustainable practices.

headline: Sacred Forest Remnants Tell Story of Virdi
summary: The remaining sacred groves in Virdi serve as a poignant reminder of past migrations when villagers relocated along with their deities. These ecological and cultural relics highlight the deep history of the region.

headline: HC Orders Equal Pension Rights for Family
summary: The High Court has directed that pension benefits must be shared equally between a deceased employee's widow and the child from his second marriage. This ruling clarifies inheritance and family pension rights under law.

headline: Arjun and Gabriella Wed in Intimate Ceremony
summary: Actor Arjun Rampal and Gabriella Demetriades have celebrated their wedding with an intimate ceremony in Goa. The couple opted for a low-key event surrounded by close family and friends.

headline: Congress Demands Colvale Jail Cash Probe
summary: The Congress party has demanded an official investigation into reports of an illegal cash-based economy operating inside the Colvale jail. They allege that prison rules are being compromised for financial gains.

headline: 24-Hour Deadline for Fixing Potholes
summary: MLA Digambar Kamat has announced a strict 24-hour target for filling up dangerous potholes on local roads to ensure commuter safety. The initiative aims to address the deteriorating state of public roads quickly.

headline: OBC Unit Demands Fair Assembly Reservation
summary: An OBC representative group in Quepem has petitioned for legislative assembly reservation quotas equivalent to those given to SC and ST communities. The demand seeks to ensure proportional political representation for backward classes.

headline: Artisans Protest Government's POP Idol Policy
summary: Traditional clay craftsmen in Goa are protesting the government's policy regulating Plaster of Paris (POP) Ganesh idols. The artisans claim the regulations harm their livelihoods and ignore traditional practices.

headline: Tito's and Seven Other Goa Clubs Sealed
summary: Authorities have sealed popular venue Tito’s along with seven other establishments in Goa as part of an ongoing drive against unauthorized clubs. The crackdown targets operations violating local licensing and safety norms.

headline: Farmers Seek Action Against WRD Over Crop Ruin
summary: Residents of Sodiem are demanding that a first information report (FIR) be filed against the Water Resources Department (WRD) for causing severe damage to their paddy crops. The farmers blame faulty water management for the agricultural losses.
